company.name: BankDhofar
company.shortDescription: BankDhofar, the best bank for you
company.description: At BankDhofar we strive to be ‘the best bank for you’ by making banking easy. BankDhofar currently has a nationwide network of 68 branches and 145 ATMs and 52 CDMs across the length and breadth of the Sultanate. As one of the fastest growing financial services institution in the Sultanate, we offer Corporate banking, Consumer banking, Treasury and Project Finance services - designed to meet the diverse needs of consumers, small and medium size businesses and mid-market companies in the region.
